cards.ex: It was a twist of fate that brought them together after so many years.
cards.exUz: Ularni shuncha yildan keyin birga olib kelgan taqdirning o'zgarishi edi.
cards.uzDef: Taqdirning kutilmagan burilishi yoki o'zgarishi, tasodifiy hodisa.

cards.ex: The discovery of penicillin was a pure act of serendipity.
cards.exUz: Penitsillinning kashf etilishi to'liq tasodifiy omad edi.
cards.uzDef: Tasodif tufayli omadli hodisa yoki kashfiyot qilish, baxtli tasodif.

cards.ex: Fortune smiled on him when he found a rare coin at the flea market.
cards.exUz: U bit bozorida noyob tanga topganda, omad unga kulib boqdi.
cards.uzDef: Omad kimningdir tarafida bo'lishi, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: This team seems to be jinxed; they always lose in the final round.
cards.exUz: Bu jamoaga ko'z tegkang o'xshaydi; ular har doim final bosqichida yutqazishadi.
cards.uzDef: Omadsiz, doimiy muvaffaqiyatsizlikka duchor bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He won the race by sheer luck; he almost tripped at the start.
cards.exUz: U poygada toza omad tufayli g'alaba qozondi; u startda deyarli yiqilib tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina omad tufayli, hech qanday mahorat yoki reja yo'qligi.

cards.ex: Finding that old painting in the attic was like a lottery win for them.
cards.exUz: Ular uchun chodirda eski rasmni topish lotereyada yutgandek bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdordagi pulni yutish, katta omad.

cards.ex: I decided to take a gamble and invest in the new company.
cards.exUz: Men tavakkal qilib, yangi kompaniyaga investitsiya qilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni o'z zimmasiga olib, biror narsaga pul tikish yoki harakat qilish.

cards.ex: "I wish I could go on holiday." "Chance would be a fine thing!"
cards.exUz: "Qaniydi ta'tilga chiqa olsam." "Omad qani endi!"
cards.term: chance would be a fine thing
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa sodir bo'lishini xohlash, lekin unga umid yo'qligini bildirish.

cards.ex: Driving that fast in such bad weather is just tempting fate.
cards.exUz: Bunday yomon ob-havoda bunchalik tez haydash taqdirni sinash bilan barobar.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki ahmoqona ish qilish, yomon oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan harakat.

cards.ex: What are the chances of us bumping into each other in this huge city?
cards.exUz: Bu ulkan shaharda bir-birimizga duch kelishimizning imkoniyati qanday?
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa sodir bo'lish ehtimolini so'rash yoki aytish.

cards.ex: Getting that internship was a real lucky break for her career.
cards.exUz: Ushbu stajirovkani olish uning faoliyati uchun haqiqiy omadli imkoniyat edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan va foydali imkoniyat, omadli vaziyat.

cards.ex: A promotion might be in the cards for him if he keeps working hard.
cards.exUz: Agar u qattiq ishlashda davom etsa, u uchun lavozim ko'tarilishi rejalashtirilgan bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan, ehtimoliy, rejalashtirilgan.

cards.ex: Let's flip a coin, heads or tails, to decide who goes first.
cards.exUz: Keling, tangani otib, birinchi kim borishini hal qilamiz, gerb yoki raqam.
cards.uzDef: Tangani otib, gerb yoki raqam tushishini taxmin qilish orqali qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: We've done all we can; now we just have to leave it to fate.
cards.exUz: Biz qo'limizdan kelganicha harakat qildik; endi shunchaki taqdirga topshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning natijasini nazorat qilmaslik, taqdirga havola qilish.

cards.ex: We're going to a new restaurant, but we're just taking pot luck with the food.
cards.exUz: Biz yangi restoranga boryapmiz, lekin biz ovqat bilan omadga ishonamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yaxshi bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi, oldindan bilmasdan ishonib harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Losing his job was a bad break, but he's determined to find something better.
cards.exUz: Ishini yo'qotishi omadsizlik edi, ammo u yaxshiroq narsa topishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Omadsiz vaziyat, yomon omad.

cards.ex: I haven't had a cold all winter, touch wood!
cards.exUz: Men qish bo'yi shamollamadim, ko'zdan saqlasin!
cards.uzDef: Omadni saqlab qolish uchun yog'ochga tegish (superstition).

cards.ex: The outcome of the game was really down to chance after that penalty.
cards.exUz: O'sha penaltidan keyin o'yin natijasi haqiqatan ham tasodifga bog'liq edi.
cards.uzDef: Tasodif yoki omadga bog'liq bo'lgan, rejalashtirilmagan.

cards.ex: Poker is often described as a game of chance, but skill is also important.
cards.exUz: Poker ko'pincha omad o'yini sifatida ta'riflanadi, ammo mahorat ham muhim.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi asosan omadga bog'liq bo'lgan o'yin.

cards.ex: I decided to take a punt on that horse even though it's a long shot.
cards.exUz: Garchi ehtimoli kam bo'lsa ham, men o'sha otga pul tikishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Tavakkal qilish, ayniqsa pul tikishda.

cards.ex: It was sheer fluke that I found the perfect dress on sale.
cards.exUz: Men sotuvda mukammal ko'ylakni topganim to'liq tasodif edi.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina tasodif tufayli sodir bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I don't know what to do, I guess I'll just have to trust my luck.
cards.exUz: Nima qilishni bilmayman, menimcha shunchaki omadimga ishonishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Natijani nazorat qilishning iloji bo'lmaganda, omadga tayanish.

cards.ex: Finding that lost wallet with all the money inside was a stroke of good fortune.
cards.exUz: Ichida barcha pullari bilan yo'qolgan hamyonni topish omadli hodisa edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan omadli voqea yoki vaziyat.

cards.ex: She won the competition against the odds, surprising everyone.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada ehtimolga qarshi g'alaba qozonib, hamma hayron qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ehtimolga zid ravishda, muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati kam bo'lgan vaziyatda.

cards.ex: By good fortune, we arrived just before the rain started.
cards.exUz: Omad tufayli, biz yomg'ir boshlanishidan oldin yetib keldik.
cards.uzDef: Omad tufayli, tasodifan yaxshi natijaga erishish.

cards.ex: You can't choose your teammates; it's just the luck of the draw.
cards.exUz: Siz jamoa a'zolaringizni tanlay olmaysiz; bu shunchaki qur'a omadi.
cards.uzDef: Omadga bog'liq bo'lgan, tanlash imkoniyati yo'qligi.

cards.ex: As chance has it, I met an old friend at the airport.
cards.exUz: Tasodifan, men aeroportda eski do'stimni uchratdim.
cards.uzDef: Tasodif tufayli, rejalashtirilmagan holda.

cards.ex: You can take your chances with the old car, but it might break down.
cards.exUz: Siz eski mashina bilan tavakkal qilishingiz mumkin, lekin u buzilib qolishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noaniq narsaga qaramasdan, harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We can't leave the success of the project to chance; we need a plan.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihaning muvaffaqiyatini tasodifga qoldira olmaymiz; bizga reja kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani rejalashtirmasdan yoki nazorat qilmasdan, omadga havola qilish.

cards.ex: I thought I'd have a punt on the stock market, see if I can make some money.
cards.exUz: Men fond bozorida tavakkal qilib ko'rmoqchiman, pul ishlashim mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli sarmoya kiritish yoki harakat qilish.
